senses.gloss: f.(b. h. רוּעַ I)blowing the trumpet, esp. T’ruʿah, a rapid succession of three notes, tremolo.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:9">R. Hash. IV, 9</cite> <he>שיעור ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00033"><he>יַבָּבָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 34a:10">Ib. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>שיעור תקיעה כת׳ שיעור ת׳ וכ׳</he> the value of a T’ḳiʿah is equal to a T’ruʿah, and that of a T’ruʿah is equal to three Sh’barim.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 34a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ת׳ בפני עצמה ות׳ וכ׳</he> t’kiʿah (the verb <he>תקע</he>) means one thing, and t’ruʿah (the verb <cite ref="T00415"><he>הריע</he></cite>) another thing; <he>תקיעה ותר׳ אחת היא</he> they mean the same; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תְּרוּעוֹת</he>. Ib. IV, 9 <he>כשלש ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00884"><he>תְּקִיעָה</he></cite>. Ib. 34ᵃ; a. fr.
